title: LayerNorm reciprocal square root underflow to infinity on zero-variance embedding vectors
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0784: LayerNorm reciprocal square root underflow to infinity on zero-variance embedding vectors
Repository: `openxla/xla`
Category: `Numerical Stability & Tensor Geometry`
Target File: `xla/service/gpu/gemm_fusion.cc`

#### Problem Description
Epsilon added outside sqrt function leads to division by zero when variance is exactly zero in FP16.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Ensure rsqrt argument is max(variance + eps, eps) to guarantee strictly positive denominator.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0784.py -q`
expected_invariant: Ensure rsqrt argument is max(variance + eps, eps) to guarantee strictly positive denominator.
